title: kate-ui: choose the light or dark theme name
summary: theme_name maps Light, Dark, and System onto Breeze Light or Breeze Dark. System follows the system_dark flag. Loading the theme file stays out of this packet. The test goes in the existing cache tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn theme_name(choice: ThemeChoice, system_dark: bool) -> &'static str

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: cache.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add ThemeChoice and theme_name. Keep the enum public inside this module. Keep the function pub(crate). Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] on the function. Light returns Breeze Light. Dark returns Breeze Dark. System returns Breeze Dark when system_dark is true, and Breeze Light otherwise. Use one match. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch theme_bits, channel_byte, or KeyedCache. Do not edit theme.rs. The existing test a_non_finite_channel_is_zero stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test theme_name_follows_the_system checks ThemeChoice::Light with true is Breeze Light. ThemeChoice::Dark with false is Breeze Dark. ThemeChoice::System with true is Breeze Dark. ThemeChoice::System with false is Breeze Light. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: cache::tests::theme_name_follows_the_system
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because theme_name does not exist. After the change Light stays Breeze Light even when the system is dark. System with system_dark true is Breeze Dark.
